fixes.explanation: I know, friend, it sounds like a trick question. A field going to the priests? But read it slowly. Leviticus 27:21 says that when the field is released in the Jubilee, it will become holy, like a field devoted to the LORD, and it becomes the property of the priests. That's the field from verse 20, the one not redeemed or sold to another man, so the statement is True.
